# `base/menubar`

An application-style menu bar sits persistently across the top of a workspace.

## Selection

- **Use when:** An application-style menu bar sits persistently across the top of a workspace.
- **Avoid when:** The menu hangs off a single button, or the bar is site navigation.
- **Consider instead:** `base/dropdown-menu`, `base/navigation-menu`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { Menubar } from "themelia-ui/base/menubar"
import "themelia-ui/base/menubar.css"
import { DropdownMenu } from "themelia-ui/base/dropdown-menu"
import "themelia-ui/base/dropdown-menu.css"
```

## Composition

This module depends on no other module.

It is used together with `base/dropdown-menu`: import that module and its stylesheet too.

Application policy—routing, fetching, persistence, permissions, and translation—stays
outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.

## Public declarations

### `Menubar`

Kind: callable.

The bar. Its menus are `DropdownMenu` roots, each holding a `MenubarTrigger` and a
`DropdownMenuContent` with every row the dropdown menu offers.

The menu itself is the dropdown menu module's, not a copy under a second name — so
groups, labels, checkbox and radio items, submenus and the portal are the dropdown
menu's parts too, and a reader who has learned one has learned the other.

```text
({ className, ...props }: MenubarProps) => import("react").JSX.Element
```

### `MenubarProps`

Kind: interface.

Extends: `MenubarPrimitive.Props`.

No own members are present in the normalized public snapshot.

### `MenubarTrigger`

Kind: callable.

One menu's word in the bar, placed inside a `DropdownMenu` beside its
`DropdownMenuContent`. Once a menu is open, moving along the bar opens the next without
a second click — which is what makes a menubar a menubar rather than a row of dropdowns.

```text
({ className, ...props }: MenuPrimitive.Trigger.Props) => import("react").JSX.Element
```

					<DropdownMenuSeparator />

						Save <DropdownMenuShortcut>⌘S</DropdownMenuShortcut>
					</DropdownMenuItem>
				</DropdownMenuContent>
			</DropdownMenu>
			<DropdownMenu>
				<MenubarTrigger>Edit</MenubarTrigger>
				<DropdownMenuContent>
					<DropdownMenuItem>Undo</DropdownMenuItem>
					<DropdownMenuItem>Redo</DropdownMenuItem>
				</DropdownMenuContent>
			</DropdownMenu>
			<DropdownMenu>
				<MenubarTrigger>View</MenubarTrigger>
				<DropdownMenuContent>
					<DropdownMenuItem>Zoom in</DropdownMenuItem>
					<DropdownMenuItem>Zoom out</DropdownMenuItem>
				</DropdownMenuContent>
			</DropdownMenu>
		</Menubar>
